The '''Charric''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] ranged energy-weapon analog to the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], notable for utilizing [[maser]]-beam technology that was prevalent in the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]].

==Description==
The [[Cheunh/Legends|Cheunh]] word "charric" was typically used to denote personal weaponry in the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], referring to handheld weapons ranging in size from [[Charric pistol|pistols]] to [[Charric rifle|rifles]].<ref name="DK III: SW" /> Occasionally, the term could also refer to larger vehicle mounted weapons and artillery-grade pieces, such as [[Maser fan]]s and [[Megamaser]]s.<ref name="DK III: SW" /> Charrics differed from [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] by firing a [[maser]]-guided particle beam, known as a maser beam, which carried significant thermal and kinetic energy.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" /><ref name="SANBRA" /> These intense microwaves created a potent bolt that was easily capable of penetrating non-metallic armors (such as ceramic and polymer armors).<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" /><ref name="SANBRA" /> Against metallic armors, the interaction between a maser bolt's microwaves and a metallic surface created a nasty electrical discharge capable of temporarily stunning or even knocking a target out cold.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" /><ref name="SANBRA" /> Despite this discharge, metallic armors provided decent protection from charrics, as the beam would not simply punch through it as it would a non-metallic armor.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" /><ref name="SANBRA" /> Charrics on their own were not capable of switching between a lethal and [[stun]] setting in the way a blaster was, and many did not come equipped with one stock.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" /><ref name="SANBRA" /> Variant models of charrics did include a stun function, however; when set on stun these variants shut off its maser and emitted a green EM-charge specially designed to disrupt neurological patterns.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" /><ref name="SANBRA" />

Charric discharges were typically actinic blue or bright green, with slightly shorter ammo capacity and range than [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].<ref name="SQ" /><ref name="DK III: SW" /><ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" /><ref name="SANBRA" /> Charrics were more or less capable of the same amount of output as a blaster, however, despite using a different technology - and the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] made extensive use of the weapons throughout their history.<ref name="SQ" /><ref name="DK III: SW" /> Because of the difference in technologies, charrics were unable to be reflected by lightsabers,<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> and also carried far more kinetic energy than a blaster bolt, with the "enormous impact" of the bolts being substantial enough to physically wear down a Jedi Knight to the point of having their lightsaber knocked from their grasp.<ref name="DK III: SW">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>

==History==
Charrics were common within Chiss space, but relatively rare in the wider galaxy until the Chiss joined the galactic community. Although the Republic at large did not know of the Chiss until the Imperial Era, the charric could still be found on Republic worlds as early as [[3951 BBY]], such as [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] and [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="kotor2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>
